summary: Comprehensive mobile responsiveness audit of BidVex platform at three viewport sizes (375px iPhone SE, 390px iPhone 14, 768px iPad). Tested 12+ pages including Homepage, Vehicle Auctions, Lots Auction, Marketplace, Auth/Login, Settings, Buyer Dashboard, Seller Dashboard, Create Listing, and Email Marketing Pricing. Found 1 CRITICAL issue (Seller Dashboard horizontal overflow), 2 HIGH issues (Buyer Dashboard tabs hidden, small tap targets), and several MEDIUM issues (form inputs below 44px tap target).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Horizontal overflow of 165px on mobile (375px). The button container 'flex gap-2' with 3 buttons causes content to extend to 540px width
ui_bugs.fix: Add 'flex-wrap' class to allow buttons to wrap on mobile: className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: Tabs 3 and 4 ('Surenchéri', 'Ma Liste de Surveillance') overflow beyond viewport on iPhone SE. Tab 3 starts at x=316px, Tab 4 at x=427px (viewport is 375px)
ui_bugs.fix: Add overflow-x-auto to TabsList container for horizontal scroll, or stack tabs vertically on mobile with responsive classes

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: Form inputs and buttons have 40px height instead of recommended 44px minimum tap target
ui_bugs.fix: Increase input and button heights to h-11 (44px) for better mobile usability

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: Login button in navbar is 56x32px - height below 44px recommended tap target
ui_bugs.fix: Increase button size to minimum 44px height

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: Some bottom nav items have 36x36px tap targets, below 44px minimum
ui_bugs.fix: Increase icon button touch targets to minimum 44x44px

issues: Menu items have proper 48px tap targets
CTA buttons stack properly on mobile
Does not significantly overlap with bottom navigation

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Seller Dashboard horizontal overflow - add 'flex-wrap' to button container at line 113 in SellerDashboard.js
HIGH: Fix Buyer Dashboard tabs overflow - add 'overflow-x-auto' to TabsList or implement responsive tabs for mobile
MEDIUM: Increase Auth form input/button heights from 40px to 44px (h-11 class)
MEDIUM: Increase navbar Login button height to 44px minimum
MEDIUM: Review and increase bottom nav icon tap targets to 44px minimum
critical_code_review_comments: SellerDashboard.js line 113: 'flex gap-2' without 'flex-wrap' causes 3 buttons to overflow on mobile
BuyerDashboard.js line 80: TabsList uses 'flex-1' for 4 tabs which overflow on narrow screens
Auth form uses default shadcn heights of 40px - consider increasing for mobile
Most pages handle mobile responsiveness well with proper use of responsive Tailwind classes
